arguments.content: An applied recovery phase is insufficient to accept an editable retry. When receipt persistence can fail after idempotent replacement and the API permits a failed operation to retry with edited values, the old applied payload must not be treated as the current submission. Reapply/record the latest payload for incomplete operations while retaining the completed-operation replay shortcut. Verify the actual apply-success/receipt-failure/edit/retry sequence; same-payload retry tests do not exercise this contract. Observed as P1 in service.py staged review against feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67; independent source review and parent execution reproduced it.
